The methods behind the OPDI data are described in two places:

- **Release v2.0.0**: the [Algorithms](algorithms/index.qmd) section has one page
  per method, each with how it is computed, what it was compared with, how
  accurate it is and its limits. [Processing steps](algorithms/processing-steps.qmd)
  shows the whole chain, and the
  [Data quality](accuracy/index.qmd) gives the accuracy of
  every item on one page.
- **Release v0.0.2**: the methods of release v0.0.2 are described in the
  [Release v0.0.2 section](data/releases.qmd#how-release-v0.0.2-was-computed)
  of Releases.

## Flight list {#flight-list}

Release v2.0.0: [Track identity](algorithms/tracks.qmd) and
[Departure and destination airports](algorithms/airports.qmd).
Release v0.0.2: [flights and departure and destination airports](data/releases.qmd#flights-and-their-identifiers).
